system.description:
Tier 3 enchantment — Wearable object

You may place this enchantment on any wearable object. When a creature has the object on themselves, they may spend a Hope to become Cloaked. While Cloaked, they remain unseen if they are stationary when an adversary moves to where they would normally see them. The effect ends when they end a move within line of sight of an adversary or when they make an attack, unless they spend an additional Hope to remain Cloaked.
